title: Grateful Dead Live at Deer Creek Music Center on 1990-07-18
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns + 1 Sennheiser 421 > Unknown Mixer (Either A Radio Shack Or Boss) 1/4 Inch In/RCA Out > Sony TC-D5m > Dolby B, Tapes:Maxell MX 90 + 100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > No Dolby > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate Software To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with superb sound captures what many consider the best summer‑tour show.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for its crystal‑clear, lively mix – described as the best‑sounding crowd recording of the tour. Reviewers also claim this concert may have been the highlight of the summer run, despite a few mislabeled tracks and the absence of an encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it rates both performance (5★) and recording quality very highly, leading to a near‑top overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, vibrant crowd mix; reviewer calls it the best‑sounding audience tape despite some mislabeled track titles.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow praised as possibly the best show of the summer tour; no encore is present.
